[c:1397f7c2001269406e05db7a64a6545bf0a82e31] For ASU drugs, GMP is Schedule T under Rule 157, and compliance is mandatory for manufacturers. [c:65a5a3b029f5081e1490aa1fa0aa701b8124f96b] So before applying, build your unit around Schedule T requirements for premises, hygiene, process control and quality control. [c:65a5a3b029f5081e1490aa1fa0aa701b8124f96b] Then prepare your product and facility documents carefully and be ready for inspection, because the system emphasises inspections of manufacturing and drug testing units. [c:1397f7c2001269406e05db7a64a6545bf0a82e31] Please confirm the current state-specific forms, checklist and sequence on the official State Ayush/Drug Controller site before spending money, because rules and formats can change.

rows.answer: For social media ads of Ayurvedic medicines, the clearest current rule in your sources is that the manufacturing license number of that particular product must be displayed in all advertisements, including social media and electronic media.[c:c080d7b84c9145e3f272dc055d82a8af6ebd18d6] You should also avoid presenting any product as “Approved/Certified by Ministry of Ayush,” because the Ministry states that it does not grant manufacturing license or approval for any Ayush drug/medicine.[c:af09588e5107b2f95e64b2dbcd2456b77db3c2c1] A State Licensing Authority license should not be presented as Ministry approval; the advisory says state licensing is only permission for sale of that particular drug/product under the Act and Rules.[c:af09588e5107b2f95e64b2dbcd2456b77db3c2c1] The advisory also flags claims such as “100% Safe,” “Free from side effects,” “Guaranteed Treatment,” and “Permanent cure,” and it also notes claims of nutraceutical value to Ayush drugs/products.[c:af09588e5107b2f95e64b2dbcd2456b77db3c2c1] For your practice page, keep posts educational and product communication strictly compliant, and please confirm the latest notice on the official Ministry of Ayush website before publishing.
